description: Main window. Deliberately NOT opener:default — that set also grants reveal-item-in-dir, which the app never calls and which would let anything running in the webview pop a file manager at an arbitrary path. allow-open-url plus allow-default-urls is what openExternal() actually needs, and allow-default-urls is the scope confining it to http/https/mailto/tel IN RUST. The regex in catalogue.ts is a convenience, not the boundary: devtools can call invoke() directly, so this file is the only thing that really constrains the IPC surface. open_path is granted nowhere, so the webview can never launch a local file.
